text: Some spaces are built on trust. This shibari workshop curates its guest list — newcomers apply with a short questionnaire before tickets unlock.
The application lives right in the flow. Answer the questions, hit submit — that's it.
While the organizers review, guests always see where they stand. No black box.
Meanwhile, in the organizer's studio, every application lands in one review queue.
Read the answers, then approve with one click — scores and notes are there when you need them.
The moment it's approved, the guest's page unlocks. Tickets are live.
Safer spaces, effortless vetting. Revel. Get started at lets revel dot io.
